title: Refrigerants and hazardous fluids.
officialText:
Heat exchange equipment that contains a refrigerant and that is part of a closed
refrigeration system shall comply with Chapter 11. Heat exchange equipment containing heat transfer fluids which are
combustible or hazardous shall comply with the New York City Fire Code. Flammable heat transfer fluids are prohibited.
SECTION MC 909
VENTED WALL FURNACES
